current_arc: The Monsoon Car Ride & Secret Pouch

history.title: തിരിച്ചുവരവ് (The Homecoming)
history.summary: Sachin and Amal plan a surprise Munnar getaway for Reenu's birthday. Just as Sachin prepares to reveal the surprise, Reenu's parents arrive unannounced at the Kochi flat, complicating everything.
history.cliffhanger: Sachin's anxiety spikes as he clutches the hidden leather pouch, realizing he must now navigate the uninvited presence of Kurian and Molly.

persistent_props: Brown leather pouch hidden behind Sachin
Brown leather pouch in Sachin's hand
Brown leather pouch in Sachin's hand behind his back
cliffhanger_scene_state.camera_lens: Cinematic prime lens, shallow depth of field

season_arc.synopsis: Sachin and Amal secretly plan a romantic getaway to Munnar for Reenu's birthday. Just as Sachin is about to show Reenu the booking, her parents, Kurian and Molly, arrive unannounced at the Kochi flat with heavy suitcases.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Kurian looks at the travel brochure on the table and asks, 'So, who is going to Munnar?'

season_arc.synopsis: Thinking quickly, Amal claims the trip was a family pilgrimage he planned for everyone. Kurian, impressed by Amal's 'values', insists that the whole group must go together in one car to bond.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Sachin realizes he has to drive his strict future father-in-law for four hours in a cramped car.

season_arc.synopsis: The morning of the trip becomes chaotic as Amal tries to fit Kurian's massive traditional trunks and Reenu's bags into the small hatchback. Sachin tries to impress Kurian by helping, but accidentally traps Kurian's mundu in the car door.
season_arc.cliffhanger: The car engine makes a strange sputtering sound just as they pull out of the driveway.

season_arc.synopsis: On the way to Adimali, Kurian insists on turning off the AC to 'enjoy the natural air' and critiques Sachin's driving style. To break the tension, Molly starts a family sing-along of old melodies, forcing Sachin and Reenu to hide their secret smiles.
season_arc.cliffhanger: A massive fog settles in as they reach the first hairpin curve, and Kurian demands to take the wheel.

season_arc.synopsis: During a tea break at a roadside stall, Sachin spills hot tea near Kurian's feet, leading to a lecture on responsibility. However, Molly pulls Sachin aside and reveals she knows about his feelings for Reenu, offering him a silent nod of encouragement.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Reenu gets a mysterious phone call from an 'old family friend' that makes Kurian look very interested.

season_arc.synopsis: The group stops at a scenic tea plantation for photos. Amal, trying to take a panoramic shot, accidentally drops the car keys into a deep thicket of tea bushes just as it starts to rain.
season_arc.cliffhanger: The sun begins to set, and they are stranded in the middle of a remote tea estate with no signal.

season_arc.synopsis: After finding the keys and reaching the resort late, they discover a booking error: only two rooms are available. Reenu and Molly take one, leaving Sachin to share a single bed room with a snoring, grumpy Kurian.
season_arc.cliffhanger: In the middle of the night, Kurian wakes up and starts questioning Sachin about his long-term financial stability.

season_arc.synopsis: During a morning trek, Kurian slips on a damp rock and nearly falls down a slope. Sachin shows incredible reflexes and physical strength to catch him, safely guiding him back while staying calm under pressure.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Kurian stays silent for the rest of the walk, looking at Sachin with a completely new expression.

season_arc.synopsis: On the final evening at a viewpoint, Kurian finally speaks to Sachin privately. He admits he was testing him the whole trip and confesses that he only wants Reenu to be with someone who can protect her in a crisis.
season_arc.cliffhanger: Kurian asks Sachin, 'So, when do you plan on bringing your parents to our house?'

season_arc.synopsis: The season concludes with a beautiful sunrise over the Nilgiris. Kurian and Molly officially give their blessing to Sachin and Reenu. Amal celebrates by finally getting the 'perfect' group photo as they head back to Kochi as one united family.
season_arc.cliffhanger: As they drive back, Sachin's phone rings—it's his parents saying they've already reached Kochi to meet the 'in-laws'.
